Salesforce.name: Salesforce
kill_points: Our pricing is 60% lower than Salesforce for equivalent features
Implementation takes 2 weeks vs 3-6 months for Salesforce
No expensive consultants needed - intuitive self-service setup
Better mobile experience with offline support

counter_objections.ecosystem: While Salesforce has more integrations, our Zapier connector provides access to 1000+ apps
counter_objections.enterprise_ready: We serve Fortune 500 companies including [Customer X]

HubSpot.name: HubSpot
kill_points: Our AI-powered lead scoring is more accurate (92% vs 78%)
Better enterprise security features (SOC 2, on-prem option)
More flexible API with higher rate limits
weaknesses: Better free tier for small businesses

counter_objections.free_tier: Our Starter plan at $29/user provides better value than HubSpot's paid Sales Hub
counter_objections.marketing: We integrate natively with HubSpot Marketing if they want best of both

Pipedrive.name: Pipedrive
kill_points: Better suited for larger sales teams (50+ reps)
weaknesses: Pipedrive is simpler and easier to learn

counter_objections.complexity: We offer free onboarding and training for all plans
counter_objections.price: TCO is lower when you factor in productivity gains

Zoho.name: Zoho CRM
kill_points: Superior AI capabilities with GPT-4 integration
weaknesses: Zoho offers full business suite (email, docs, etc.)

counter_objections.suite: We integrate with Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 for full productivity
counter_objections.price: Our Professional plan includes features that are add-ons with Zoho
